semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor packaging equipment and advanced manufacturing solutions.
summary: Jiangsu QuickCore Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on developing and providing advanced semiconductor packaging equipment solutions. Their product offerings include micro-nano metal sintering equipment, vacuum/formic acid welding furnaces, and high-speed die bonders, catering to the needs of the semiconductor packaging industry.

regional_presence.China: The company has established a new 75,000-square-meter factory in Jiangsu, indicating a strong manufacturing presence in the region.
